name: backdrop-generator
description: Generates .mp4 backdrop clips from your Jellyfin/Emby movie and TV libraries using FFmpeg. Supports audio control and expert mode for custom FFmpeg parameters. Fully configurable via Unraid UI.

paths.name: TV Folder
paths.description: Path to your TV Shows folder.

variables.name: Clip Length
variables.description: Length of each backdrop clip in seconds.

variables.name: CRF
variables.description: Compression quality (lower is better quality, 28–30 recommended).

variables.name: Interval
variables.description: Time between scans in seconds (default: 6 hours).

variables.name: Force Overwrite
variables.description: Force re-generation even if backdrop already exists.

variables.name: No Audio
variables.description: Generate clips without audio (default: false = include audio).

variables.name: Expert Mode - Custom FFmpeg Parameters
variables.description: Advanced: Additional FFmpeg parameters (e.g., '-movflags +faststart -pix_fmt yuv420p'). Leave empty for default behavior.
